title: Jactitation
summary: JAC'TITATION, noun [Latin jactito, jacto. It ought rather to be jactation, Latin jactatio.] 1. A tossing of the body; restlessness. 2. A term in the canon law for a false pretension to marriage; vain

inlines.v: JAC'TITATION, noun [Latin jactito, jacto. It ought rather to be jactation, Latin jactatio.] 1. A tossing of the body; restlessness. 2. A term in the canon law for a false pretension to marriage; vain boasting.
